subject: Implement SOUL + ops prompt loader
description:
In `capo/agent.py`, on boot: read `souls/<active>.md` (path from `config.toml [soul] active/dir`) and prepend it to `prompts/system.md`. Construct the composite instructions string once per process and pass to `Agent(instructions=<composite>)`.

Create exemplar files: `souls/default.md`, `souls/concise.md`, `prompts/system.md`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] On boot, `capo/agent.py` reads `souls/<active>.md` and prepends to `prompts/system.md`.
- [ ] Composite instructions string constructed exactly once per process; agent created with `instructions=<composite>`.
- [ ] Default model read from `config.toml [models] default`; configurable via config edit + restart only (no per-run override in V1).
- [ ] Two soul files exist: `souls/default.md`, `souls/concise.md`.
- [ ] SOUL file > 50 lines: boot succeeds, warning logged ("SOUL is longer than recommended").

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Active soul file missing: boot fails with clear error citing the path checked.
- [ ] `prompts/system.md` missing: boot fails with clear error.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: composite instructions equal `<soul>\n\n<system_prompt>`
• Unit: missing soul → boot error with path
• Unit: missing system.md → boot error
• Unit: SOUL file > 50 lines triggers warning

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.1, 9.1
